title: SDK/API interop runway: samples, telemetry wiring, and compatibility checklist for function-calling + structured streaming
creator: Evan Brooks
description: Coordinate cross-team launch readiness for SDK + API surface changes that enable function-calling, structured output schemas, and streaming responses. This ticket covers finalizing release notes copy, tying sample apps to the correct SDK versions, ensuring telemetry events are wired for streaming/function-call flows, and publishing a concise compatibility matrix and migration guide. We need clear owners for docs, QA, SDK samples, and telemetry dashboards, and a preflight checklist that product and eng can run the day before release.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted and approved by Docs + PM with field-friendly bullet points and migration snippets
All SDK sample repos updated to reference sdk-2025.03 and pass CI in the staging environment
Telemetry events for streaming start/stop, chunk_count, function_call_invocation, and schema_validation_failure are instrumented and visible in the console QA dashboard
Compatibility matrix published showing which SDK versions support structured output shapes and function-calling argument coercion
Migration guide with at least three real-world code examples (python/node/go) added to docs and linked from release notes
Preflight checklist completed (see tasks) and sign-off from ENG/QA/Docs/Support
